hypothesis: Training E on diverse multipath/calibration environments improves the frozen per-bin phase readout on unseen mp_cal environments relative to untrained E and single-path training.

data.multipath: gen_hard(..., 'mp_cal', snr) for SNR groups 0/5/10 dB; train 512 sources per SNR, val 128 per SNR
data.single_path_control: gen8(..., snr) for the same SNR groups and source seeds; no multipath/calibration

training.mask: 30% random 4x4 TF blocks in E output grid; input mask nearest-upsampled to T=29
training.scale: one positive scalar from train data RMS; stored in results meta

evaluation.readout: per-bin cross-product ridge to [cos(phi), sin(phi)] of geometric direct path; fit on 8103; eval on 8102; 28 pairs; grid tau [-130,130] us
evaluation.aggregation: median over 3 seeds plus seed range; no p-values

decision_rule.pass: multipath-trained recon or jepa >=20% better than untrained and the matching single-path control on mp_cal 10 dB for >=2/3 seeds
decision_rule.raw_reference: best E should be <=3x raw phase-slope
decision_rule.fail: otherwise record negative result; P1 still tests the phase-aware objective; P5 only by separate decision

limits: synthetic static multipath; 1-2 reflections; calibration in STFT domain
mono per-channel E, no Fusion; hybrid_small proxy for E-S
10k steps and 3 seeds are repetition, not independent environments
diagnostic only; not an E gate or field result
